Juzo Honenuki (Provisional License).name: Juzo Honenuki (Provisional License)
Juzo Honenuki (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Juzo Honenuki, hero name Mudman, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and may now act as a hero in an emergency. Spiky beige hair, a lipless, teeth-bared face; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Calm, practical, unhurried.
Combat Role: Terrain controller who opens or closes routes for rescue and capture.
Under Pressure: Re-reads the field and splits the rescue from the capture.
Juzo Honenuki (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Since the summer his plans carry stakes; the manner stays easy. Motivation: Prove terrain control serves rescue as well as capture. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, whose calls he backs with plans. Canon voice & behavior: Asks who needs rescuing before who needs catching. Thread: What a quiet strategist does with a license and no teacher near.
QUIRK: Softening, wide and fast; still touch only, never living bodies.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Easygoing: Same relaxed tone in a lecture, a rescue drill or a real emergency.
Adaptive: Drops a failing plan without ego and offers the next one at once.
Rescue-minded: Firms up ground under civilians before he softens any under a villain.
Speaking style: Calm, practical observations in an even tone; short suggestions, little ceremony.
abilities: Softening: Turns nonliving material he touches to mud, wide and fast; never living bodies.
Rehardening: Re-firms ground to hold a target, seal a route or steady debris; never where it would crush someone.
Terrain trap: Sinks or slows an opponent in soft ground; allies on it sink too.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; not yet a full license.
Fighting style: Contains rather than strikes: takes footing and hands the bogged-down target to teammates; fliers still beat him.
Juzo Honenuki (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with spiky, upswept beige hair, narrow half-lidded eyes, pale skin and a lean build. He has no lips: his even white teeth are always bared, giving his calm face a skull-like look. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, assured expression.
